title: Education Benefits Enrollment Verification and Payment Calendar
content:
**Student fact sheet — the monthly calendar of Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education).**

Every tier of Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education) shares one monthly calendar for enrollment verification and the payments that depend on it.

| Tier | Monthly verification required before the month's housing or monthly payment is released | Consecutive unverified months after which payments to the student stop | Day of the month from which the month just completed may be verified | Day of the following month on which a verified month is paid |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | Yes | 2 | 31 (the last day of a shorter month) | 1 |
| Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (Chapter 35) | Yes | 2 | 31 (the last day of a shorter month) | 1 |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | Yes | 2 | 31 (the last day of a shorter month) | 1 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 60% Benefit Level | Yes | 2 | 31 (the last day of a shorter month) | 1 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 70% Benefit Level | Yes | 2 | 31 (the last day of a shorter month) | 1 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 80% Benefit Level | Yes | 2 | 31 (the last day of a shorter month) | 1 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 90% Benefit Level | Yes | 2 | 31 (the last day of a shorter month) | 1 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 100% Benefit Level | Yes | 2 | 31 (the last day of a shorter month) | 1 |

**How the calendar reads**

- The opening day is day 31, capped at the month's last day: in a 30-day month verification opens on the 30th, in February on its last day, and in a 31-day month on the 31st.
- The figure 2 counts consecutive months: one unverified month followed by a verified month does not reach it; two unverified months in a row do.
- A month that is verified is paid on day 1 of the following month.

*Hypothetical calendar:* for training in April (30 days), verification opens on April 30 and the verified month is paid on May 1.
